record.body:
## Description

R10: After the backfill, every effort in the user-confirmed mapping has an active placement that names its mapped area.

## Approach

Human stop. List the efforts with `canon list --type score:effort` and the areas with `canon list --type composer:area`. Propose a mapping of every effort to an area, and name any area that does not exist yet. Show it to the user and wait for confirmation or changes. Create any confirmed new area. Run `orchestra place <effort> <area>` for each confirmed pair. Leave efforts the user does not map unplaced.

payload.title: Place the existing efforts in their areas
